blind.description: A stylized low-poly wooden trough or bin elevated on four short corner legs. The bin is constructed from warm brown timber planks with pale plaster or clay splatters. It is filled to near the brim with wet, sculpted grey clay or mortar showing hand or tool indentations. Two rectangular grey stone bricks rest on the back rim of the container. Geometry is solid, clean, and continuous with no hovering elements or broken geometry.
blind.from_above: A rectangular wooden frame with square corner post caps, enclosing a textured grey mortar or clay surface with curved depressions, and two grey bricks resting on the upper wooden edge.
blind.height_vs_figure: About 2 feet tall (reaching roughly knee height on the 5 ft 9 in figure) and approximately 2.5 to 3 feet across at the widest dimension.
